Kings New York, New York 10017 902 Broadway, 13th Floor T - (212) 922-9700 NewYork,NY10010 F-(212) 922-0881 ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THISZONING LOTDEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (this"Agreement"),made as of July 2l, 2006, between Rugged Cross Baptist Church (the “Church"), a New York religious corporation with an address at 1084 Lafayette Avenue, Brooklyn, New York 11221 and Rugged Cross, L.P. (*"Developer"), a New York limited partnership with an address at 151 Seventh Avenue, 2"d Floor, Brooklyn, New York 11215. WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,the Church is the owner in fee title of a certain parcel of land,with the buildings and improvements thereon, in Brooklyn, New York, known as and by the street address 1084 Lafayette Avenue,Brooklyn, New York 11221,designated as Block 1612, Lot 35 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, Kings County, and more particularly described in Exhibit A-1 annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land and tax lot being hereinafter referred to as the “Church Land"; and together with the buildings and improvements thereon and any future additions, alterations and replacements thereof being hereinafter referred to as the *Church Property"); and WHEREAS,Developer is the owner infee title of certainvacant parcels of land,in Brooklyn, New York, known as and by the street address 1086-1098 Lafayette Avenue, Brooklyn, New York, designated as Block 1612, Lots 39,40, 41 & 42 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, Kings County, and more particularly described in Exhibit A-2 annexed hereto and made a part thereof (said land and tax lots being hereinafter collectively referred to as the“Developer Land” and, together with any building or improvements place thereon hereinafter referred to as, the “Developer Property"; the Church Land and the Developer Land are herein sometimes jointly referred to as the "Parcels" and each individually as a "Parcel"); and  WHEREAS,the Developer and the Church desire to create and maintain a Single Zoning Lot (as hereinafter defined) and to allocate the Floor Area Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) between each other asset forth below. NOW THEREFORE,in consideration of Ten Dollars ($10.00) and other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which is hereby acknowledged, the parties hereto agree as follows: ARTICLE I DECLARATIONOFRESTRICTIONS Section l.1 The parties hereto are, simultaneously herewith, executing and delivering a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions, as defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution (the “Declaration"), a copy of the Declaration is annexed hereto as Exhibit B and made a part hereof,which seeks to effectuate the intentions of the parties by creating a single zoning lot (herein called the “Single Zoning Lot") comprising both the Church Land and the Developer Land.
